technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven for dependency management and builds, upgrading Reactor to 2.0.4 via parent POM and dependencyManagement.

Implement @EnableModule using a custom ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar and BeanFactoryPostProcessor that detects @Input/@Output methods/fields and registers Spring Integration channel beans and channel adapters automatically.
Extract the serialization codec into a Spring Integration module and publish it as a separate Maven artifact; Spring XD will consume it via a standard dependency.
For HA of XD-Admin on Ambari, scale the XD-Admin component to multiple instances and rely on existing ZooKeeper-based coordination plus a load balancer.
For Maven-based module installation, use Eclipse Aether (Maven resolver) inside the XD CLI to fetch artifacts and install them into the runtime module registry.
For Cloud Foundry support, implement the XD Admin SPI by adapting the spring-cloud-data ModuleLauncher and interacting with the Cloud Foundry Cloud Controller API.
CI migration to EC2 will use infrastructure-as-code or bootstrapping scripts to provision Jenkins agents, reusing existing pipeline definitions.
Kryo optimizations will use a pooled Kryo instance with registered custom serializers; guidelines will be documented in project docs.
assumptions: A single developer performs all tasks; effort excludes code review wait times, meetings, and calendar elapsed time.
One workday equals 8 hours of focused development effort.
The developer has prior working knowledge of Spring, Spring XD, Ambari, and Cloud Foundry, so no training time is included.
Existing automated test suites are sufficient; no major new test infrastructure is required beyond CI migration.
Required target environments (Ambari cluster, EC2 account, Cloud Foundry space, Maven repository) are available for testing.
The referenced spikes for U8 provide sufficient direction; final implementation effort is for production-grade code.
All user stories are in scope for the same release increment and are integrated together.
